Active Questions:@pricyprovinces: What's the origin of your forum name? Please answer with a poem (form is up to you).

It took me a while to come up with a way to explain the reason AND put into poem form so hopefully a double haiku will suffice.

Dominion led me

to find sentinels and games

seven coins a turn

Rough when they cost eight

bird band cowork inside joke

pricyprovinces!

(For the long story....Basically I lived in pennsylvania for a short time (about when Vengeance had just been released) and I wasn't into board games that much at the time. My dad being a biologist, got a job at a bird banding site and the company also invited any voulunteers that would band birds for free. So my dad talked to his boss and allowed my brother and I to come every other day and be a voulunteer at that bird banding "lab". During one of those days some of the co-workers got out Dominion and invited me to play at which the "pricyprovinces" joke was created. After that I got into board games in general a lot more and during another game party at the bosses house he asked my brother and I if we would wan't to play this cool looking game called "sentinels" that he just purchased, and that because I was wearing a green lanturn shirt he thought I might like it. After the first game it became my favorite and still is today. So that explains it as well as how I got into sentinels and games in general.)
